inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Chrome Extension (CRX) - Malicious Extension Install Detection

properties.description: Detects the creation of Chrome extension files (.crx) that match known malicious extension IDs. Malicious CRX files on endpoints can indicate an attacker dropped or installed a malicious extension (e.g., credential harvesters, redirectors, miners). The rule flags CRX creation with known bad IDs and requires available file hashes for further investigation.

| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".crx"
// FileName may be "<extension_id>.crx" or include the ID; check substrings against known IDs
| where FileName has_any(MaliciousChromeExtensionID) or FolderPath has_any("Chrome", "Extensions", "Edge")
| where isnotempty(SHA1) or isnotempty(SHA256)
| extend DetectionType = "Malicious Chrome Extension (CRX) Created"
| project Timestamp,
          DeviceId,
          DeviceName,
          FolderPath,
          FileName,
          SHA1,
          SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ReportId,
          DetectionType
| order by Timestamp desc
